info.title: Upload Assistant API
info.description: Local-first Chinese PT retorrent automation with durable steps, rule gates, and auditable evidence.

get.description: Returns lightweight summaries without attributes; fetch one log context for full recursively-redacted evidence. Uses an opaque (occurred_at,id) cursor and never computes an exact total.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trigram-indexed summary search over message, error, action, detail, method, route and request ID.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: Selected log with bounded same-trace logs and audit actions

get.description: Filtered lightweight summary SSE; full attributes remain available only from the per-log context endpoint.

200.description: SSE stream with monotonic IDs and resumable delivery

post.description: Explicit two-stage external provider probe. catalog performs GET /v1/models; inference validates the configured protocol, model and buffered-or-SSE transport.
Queues a diagnosis for exactly one existing job_id, incident_id, or operational log_id. UUID targets must be complete; request/trace prefixes are correlation evidence, not diagnostic targets.

200.description: Validated result and immutable evidence hash

202.description: Bounded follow-up queued against unchanged evidence

200.description: Local capacity, queue, incident, and backup overview
Age recipient and backup schedule metadata
Audited policy; generated private identity is shown once

202.description: Backup deferred for an active write job

200.description: Encrypted bundle checksum and age envelope verified

get.description: Read-only local configuration preflight. It performs no tracker, downloader, image-host, metadata-provider, or media-manager calls and never authorizes live upload.

200.description: Machine-readable local live-configuration handoff without external execution
Redacted in-app and external delivery audit

post.description: Resolves an outcome_unknown external notification. verified_not_delivered explicitly permits one queued retry; verified_delivered never calls the endpoint again. Telegram/Discord bind an exact numeric message id; enterprise WeChat/Feishu expose no message id.

200.description: Notification reconciled without an implicit remote retry

schema.description: Opaque stable pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: Recursively redacted global configuration and external-action audit events

get.description: Returns one operator-facing final issue and only the solutions valid for the current durable state.

post.description: Applies only an advertised executable action bound to the exact current status, step, and primary blocker. It cannot approve rules, override duplicates, reconcile remote writes, confirm upload, or waive seeding.

get.description: Integrity-verifies and returns the generated target package for operator review before live upload.

post.description: Queues a new immutable package revision, retains prior evidence, invalidates downstream steps, and resets confirm_upload=false.

get.description: Lists durable step attempts in workflow order. Raw input snapshots are replaced with SHA-256 evidence and error/output details are recursively redacted.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

get.description: Downloads only non-secret evidence kinds after size and SHA-256 verification. Source, generated, and downloaded torrent payloads are always denied.

post.description: Pauses at a durable boundary. In-flight downloader_add, image_upload, target_upload, and target_inject external writes reject mid-step interruption.

Queues a paused, blocked, or failed job. Unknown target/image upload outcomes and partial or unknown downloader adds require an explicit attempt-bound reconciliation decision; a generic retry is rejected with reconciliation_required.
Cancels without deleting evidence. In-flight downloader_add, image_upload, target_upload, and target_inject external writes reject mid-step interruption.

Creates a new linked job only from a blocked, failed, or cancelled job. Rule acceptance, manual obligations, resume state, and live-upload confirmation are never inherited. Running/paused/complete jobs, reconciliation-required or unknown external outcomes, active recovery, and jobs with any completed downloader, target, or image-host write are rejected.

200.description: Site adapters and active rule fingerprints

put.description: Create or update site display metadata, aliases, tags, and enabled state. Aliases never replace the canonical site code in workflow requests; a configured site does not imply runtime adapter support.

get.description: Returns the fail-closed effective policy merged from an active approved v2 rule and stricter operator limits.

put.description: Configures operator limits but cannot authorize a v1, forbidden, or undetermined rule or relax rule-derived restrictions.

get.description: Read the ordered HTTPS rule-page source set, per-source authentication mode, and redacted Cookie-presence metadata. Secret values and captured rule text are never returned.

put.description: Save 1..20 exact HTTPS rule-page URLs, their evidence IDs/scopes, per-source none/site_cookie authentication mode, and explicit completeness/Cookie-host confirmations. Cookie-host confirmation is required only for site_cookie sources. This performs no external call.

post.description: Explicitly queue one manual source refresh. Public sources are fetched without credentials; site_cookie sources decrypt and send the existing Cookie only to confirmed exact hosts. The worker shares the normal interval/quota/cooldown/concurrency policy, stores bounded normalized evidence, streams provider inference, imports an immutable draft, and never approves or activates it.

200.description: Collection status and bounded source evidence

get.description: SSE status stream with heartbeats; it observes the durable worker and never starts another collection or provider call.

post.description: Imports structured Markdown as an immutable draft. A draft with source.complete=false cannot be approved or activated.

markdown.description: YAML front matter followed by at most 8 MiB of decoded UTF-8 rule text; keep source.complete=false until the relevant current rules have been fully reviewed.

post.description: Explicitly sends operator-pasted rule text or the server-bound immutable original of source_revision_id to a configured provider enabled for rule_analysis and returns a validated editable v2 Markdown draft. Inputs larger than one model-call budget are split on source lines, extracted sequentially, and conservatively merged within one configured total timeout. Each call allows up to 8192 completion tokens. Successful SSE is parsed and hashed incrementally without retaining raw reasoning events; normalized SSE output and successful buffered responses are limited to 8 MiB, failed buffered responses to 1 MiB, and each aggregate SSE event to 1 MiB. Only a normal protocol completion is accepted; token-limit and incomplete outputs are rejected without JSON repair. Classified transient SSE error events and pre-stream HTTP 502/503/504/520-524 gateway failures receive one same-transport retry within the total timeout; permanent provider errors are not retried. Provider failures return stable codes such as provider_timeout, provider_output_truncated, or provider_stream_error. Operational logs retain request/response structure, byte counts, hashes, usage and bounded redacted SSE error evidence, never prompt or model-output content. It never imports, approves, activates, or authorizes the rule.

Web-oriented SSE form of site rule analysis. It flushes an initial event and periodic progress heartbeats while the configured provider runs, then emits analysis-result or analysis-error. Idempotency-Key is required; same-actor replays with the same input share the in-flight call or receive its bounded cached result, while key reuse with different input is rejected. The external inference and rule safety semantics are identical to /api/v2/site-rules/analyze.

200.description: SSE progress and terminal event stream

get.description: Read the in-flight or completed result for the current actor and Idempotency-Key after a Web SSE connection is interrupted by a transport time limit. This never starts or repeats provider inference. Returns 202 while analysis is running, the validated draft on completion, or the original structured provider failure.

202.description: The original provider call is still running

get.description: Read the three executable hard-gate review sections (upload, download, category-aware naming), localized facts, source conflicts, advisories, persisted decisions, blockers, and progress for the exact revision fingerprint.

put.description: Persist one human section decision bound to the exact current fingerprint. A needs_changes decision requires a comment and blocks approval.

post.description: Derive a new immutable draft with explicitly corrected upload-limit, download-limit, or category naming data. Review comments are audit-only and are never interpreted as executable configuration. The source revision remains unchanged, section confirmations reset for the new fingerprint, and the result is neither approved nor activated.

data.description: Section-specific corrected executable data. upload_limit accepts upload and seedbox_upload; naming accepts the complete naming object.

201.description: Corrected immutable draft created or reused by fingerprint

200.description: Complete rule revision approved after all three executable hard gates were confirmed for the exact fingerprint

post.description: Remove one pending draft from the maintenance workspace by marking it retired. Immutable source, fingerprint, review evidence, and audit history are retained.

200.description: Draft retired and retained for audit
Credential disabled without deleting encrypted history
Remote downloaders with redacted credential metadata

get.description: Authoritative native runtime capability catalog. Adapters with runtime_supported=false may only be saved disabled.
Returns the fingerprinted, credential-free capability and safety-gate contract for every callable adapter plus every configured-but-not-callable site profile. Performs no external calls.
Explicit read-only dashboard snapshot. Concurrent reads are coalesced and briefly cached. Torrent save paths, tracker URLs and credentials are excluded.

post.description: Persists an add-intent audit before the remote write. Ambiguous or partial results return a blocked response with expected hash evidence and must be reconciled by read-only inspection before any further add.

200.description: Torrent state and mapped path evidence

get.description: Explicitly read one torrent's files. The response page is bounded even when the downloader returns a larger file set.

post.description: Persists a limit-write intent before applying remote limits, then reads both limits back. Ambiguous writes, mismatched read-back, or result-audit failures return a blocked reconciliation response and must not be retried blindly.

Explicit external-write probe that uploads one built-in 100x100 PNG compatible with normal thumbnail pipelines. The remote host may retain the image. The upload intent and bounded receipt evidence are audited and ambiguous outcomes are never retried automatically.

200.description: Test image uploaded and receipt validated
Notification channels with credential field names only

post.description: Explicitly send one durable test message. The delivery intent is persisted before the external write, automatic retry is disabled, and an ambiguous result remains reconcilable through the notification record.

200.description: Test notification delivered with a validated receipt

409.description: Delivery outcome is unknown and requires reconciliation

200.description: Sonarr and Radarr instances with credential field names only
TMDb and PTGen providers with credential field names only

post.description: Explicitly execute one read-only production-contract lookup against a stable public reference. The response returns hashes and call metadata only, never titles or descriptions. Transport, DNS, TLS, timeout, authentication, rate-limit, invalid-response and missing-output failures use safe stable error codes; an unreachable workers.dev PTGen endpoint recommends a reachable custom domain.

200.description: Normalized IDs, bounded description, and hash evidence

get.description: Parses only a single Python config literal from the fixed read-only legacy mount. Python is never executed and secret values are never returned.

200.description: Redacted migration preview and source fingerprint
Redacted migration history and encrypted archive retention state

post.description: Imports a previously reviewed exact fingerprint. No external service is contacted and original files are never modified or deleted.

200.description: An identical completed import returned idempotently without resource writes

OperationalLogSummary.description: Lightweight recursively-redacted scalar summary. Large attributes are intentionally omitted.

base_url.description: A root URL is normalized to /v1; an explicit path is preserved.

streaming_enabled.description: Use SSE for inference so long-running compatible providers expose progress and avoid buffered gateway idle limits.

source_revision_id.description: Bind analysis to the immutable Markdown original stored for this revision; client source fields are ignored.

auth_mode.description: Authentication for this exact source. none sends no site credential; site_cookie sends only the encrypted site Cookie.

cookie_required.description: True only when at least one source uses site_cookie.

provider_config_sha256.description: Non-secret fingerprint of the exact endpoint/model/protocol/data-boundary/credential-version contract bound when queued.

generate_identity.description: Generate an X25519 identity; its private value is returned once and never stored.

fingerprint.description: Master-keyed HMAC; never a plain hash of secret-bearing source content.

source_fingerprint.description: Exact master-keyed HMAC-SHA256 returned by preview; not a plain source hash.

archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 over encrypted archive metadata and ciphertext, never the plaintext archive.

evidence.description: Non-empty per-job human evidence is required for blocking manual obligations.

target_downloader.description: Target seeding settings. Defaults to the source downloader and the verified parent save path; skip_checking and paused must remain false.

confirm_upload.description: A later live target upload gate requires an explicit true value; it is never inferred.

save_path.description: Normalized absolute path as seen by the remote downloader.

apply_labels.description: Explicitly set false for an adapter whose capability reports category=false or tags=false; category and tags must then be empty.

RetorrentDownloader.description: Source-download or target-seeding settings. An active site rule revision can impose a stricter rate cap, which always wins. Target injection always requires skip_checking=false and paused=false. apply_labels=false is an explicit audited omission for capability-limited adapters and cannot be combined with category or tags. These fields can also be supplied in resume_state after a configuration block.

profile.description: Latest enabled immutable screenshot profile revision.

name.description: Configured ImgBB, PTPimg, Imgbox, or Pixhost integration name.

RetorrentMetadataProviders.description: No provider is contacted unless its name is explicitly present. Missing required metadata later produces a resumable blocker.

SubmitDailyCandidateRequest.description: This request deliberately has no accept_rules or confirm_upload fields. The created retorrent job must satisfy those gates later.

notification_channels.description: Existing enabled channels explicitly selected for this schedule.

message_id.description: Required for verified_delivered on Telegram/Discord; omit for enterprise WeChat/Feishu and for verified_not_delivered. The server validates against the configured adapter.

naming_profile.description: Explicit resource-class naming profile selected from the active target rule.

category.description: Current MTEAM category id when the adapter cannot infer it safely.

category_evidence.description: Human-readable reason or current category-page evidence for an explicit category.

standard.description: MTEAM resolution id; normally derived from MediaInfo.

imdb_id.description: Explicit reviewed identity only when the immutable target package has no IMDb link. A conflicting value is blocked and cannot replace package identity.

attempt_id.description: Exact latest blocked/failed attempt returned by the attempts API.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the operator-reviewed external reconciliation evidence; raw evidence and credentials are not copied into the job event.

observed_hash.description: Required for a partial or unknown downloader add and must match the exact submitted hash in the persisted reconciliation template.

observed_torrent_id.description: Required for verified_uploaded; the worker performs a fresh read-only target search and must observe this exact torrent id.

submitted_torrent_sha256.description: Required for target verified_uploaded and must equal the immutable submitted target torrent SHA-256 in the persisted reconciliation template.

pending_evidence_sha256.description: Required for image verified_uploaded and must equal the server-generated pending image evidence SHA-256 in the persisted reconciliation template.

evidence.description: Credential-free submitted torrent hashes, torrent SHA-256, adapter configuration SHA-256, and any trustworthy remote observation.
Credential-free read-back evidence when available; it may be empty if the read-back itself failed.

stop_after_step.description: Optional boundary in the current workflow definition. The original boundary is not inherited.

input_snapshot.description: The raw durable snapshot is never returned. The API exposes only {redacted:true,sha256:<digest>}.

error_details.description: Recursively redacted stable failure or blocker details.

limits_available.description: False when the list transport cannot safely read per-torrent limits without an unbounded number of remote calls.

network_class.description: Operator-reviewed network type; never inferred from the name, host, or IP.

credentials.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned.

apply_labels.description: Must be explicitly false, with empty category/tags, when adapter capabilities do not support labels.

download_limit.description: Bytes per second; zero disables the limit.

upload_limit.description: Bytes per second; zero disables the limit.

credentials.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned. api_key is required for ImgBB/PTPimg and omitted for Imgbox/Pixhost.

event_types.description: Only explicitly listed high-level job events are delivered. Empty or omitted keeps the channel schedule-only.

credentials.description: telegram_bot accepts bot_token and chat_id; webhook adapters accept webhook_url. Values are encrypted and never returned.

width.description: Omit or use 0 to preserve source width.
